create_speech_recognition_pipeline: create an AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline to transcribe audio files or raw waveforms into text
run_speech_recognition_with_timestamps: run the pipeline with return_timestamps to get word or character level timestamps
build_whisper_longform_transcription: build long-form Whisper transcription using chunk_length_s and stride_length_s parameters
test_ctc_with_language_model: test CTC speech recognition with a BeamSearchDecoderCTC language model for boosted decoding
refactor_stride_rescaling: refactor stride rescaling between audio space and token/logit space for accurate chunk overlap handling
